question: Elphinstone was the Governor of which province of India during 1819-27?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bombay.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Elphinstone:-**

 
 
• It was a **British statesman, diplomat, and colonial administrator **who served as the **Governor of Bombay** from **1819 to 1827.**
 
• During his tenure, Elphinstone introduced several reforms in Bombay, including the establishment of the **Bombay University.**
 
• Elphinstone was also known for his efforts to **promote education **and improve the** condition of the poor** in Bombay.
 
 
 
• Bombay:-
 
 
• Bombay was a province of British India that covered the western part of the Indian subcontinent.
 
• It included the present-day states of Maharashtra, Gujarat, and parts of Karnataka.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **North West Frontier Province:** This province was created in** 1901** and it was located in the north-western region of British India.

 
 
• It is now part of** Pakistan.**
 
 
 
• **Madras:** Madras was a province of British India that covered the** southern part **of the Indian subcontinent.
 
 
• It was created in** 1801** and it was renamed as **Tamil Nadu **after India's independence.
 
 
 
• **Bengal: **Bengal was a province of British India that covered the **eastern part** of the Indian subcontinent.
 
 
• It was divided into** East Bengal and West Bengal **after India's independence.
